name: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Manila Leg 3
short_description: A Runrio-organized race in Pasay, Philippines on September 6, 2026, offering 32km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances.
ai_summary: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Manila Leg 3 is a road race organized by Runrio under the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia brand, scheduled for September 6, 2026, at SM Mall of Asia in Pasay, Philippines. Runners can choose from four distances: 32km, 21.1km (half-marathon, the primary distance), 10km, and 5km. Registration details have not yet been announced.
